I only had the one example video, so the script is untested on any other clip.\n\n**How it works:**\n1. It subtracts the first frame, which has no runner, from every frame, after correcting for overall brightness drift. It also applies a small blur, a 5×5 noise filter and a cutoff at row 375, below the ground plane.\n2.
